context:
Goal: the red main lifts, so every queued merge can resume.
Problem (goal): the revert of #3596 is the only merge allowed on a red main, and a guard refuses every session's ready mark on it, so only you can move it.
Based on (read): the coordinator's relay at 01:41 CST of the consultant's 01:40 CST report: the guard that checks the records page before a ready mark refuses, saying that main's merge settings hold the value none for the required CI checks and that this value is not valid; any session's mark hits it.
Based on (read): triage read at 01:43 CST: main's merge settings say no CI check is required (your Nov 16 ruling that private repos merge with no CI run, so this value is the valid one), and #3607 is open and still a draft. The refusing guard's own code was not found by triage (unmeasured), so the refusal looks like a false alarm.
Departs from: main refuses every session's ready mark while stamp.json holds the merge value none — a lets #3607's one mark through on your typed override and a lane later teaches the guard that value; c lets your own click in GitHub mark it; b leaves the refusal in place until that guard fix lands.
Meanwhile: every other queued merge waits behind the red main.
Waiting on: you.

options.gain: The red main lifts at the next merge.
options.how: Type your words in the session that marks #3607 ready (the consultant's), naming that one mark.
options.label: You type one `override` for the ready mark on #3607, then a lane fixes the guard
options.lose: One guard check is bypassed once, and your override may not reach a guard that refuses a mark (unmeasured).

options.label: Wait: a lane fixes the guard first, with no bypass
options.lose: That lane's own ready mark hits the same guard, so it likely cannot land while main is red (unmeasured), and every queued merge keeps waiting.

options.gain: No override and no guard change; the guard checks sessions, so a click in the web page likely skips it (unmeasured).
options.how: Open the #3607 link and press the button that marks the pull request ready for review.
options.label: You mark #3607 ready yourself in GitHub
options.lose: One click from you, and the guard's records-page check is not run for this mark.

title: A guard refuses the ready mark on the revert of #3596, and that revert is the only merge that lifts the red main. How does #3607 get marked ready?
